output.review_comment:
Requesting changes. I couldn't see the docstrings or tests, only the diff, so this is based on the diff alone. The PR has no description and changes three separate rules at once without explaining any of them:

1. Periods: rounding down became rounding up, so a partial period now counts as a full one. This raises the fee whenever days_late isn't an exact multiple of PERIOD_DAYS.
2. Rounding: the percentage fee used to round down and now rounds to the nearest cent (+5000 before // 10000).
3. Cap and minimum order: the old order was minimum first, then cap, so the fee never went over balance_cents // 5. The new order is `max(min(fee, cap), MINIMUM_FEE_CENTS)`, so the minimum now overrides the 20% cap. For small balances the fee can exceed 20% of the balance, and even the whole balance (e.g. a 100¢ balance gets charged the full minimum fee). This is the most worrying change. A 20% cap is a strong sign that the cap is meant to be the final limit.

The teammate said the docstrings are the source of truth. Please add a description that quotes the docstring text requiring each change and names the tests each one fixes. Drop any change the docstrings don't clearly require. Keep the cap as the final limit unless the docstring explicitly says the minimum wins. As it stands, this looks like changing several rules until the tests pass, not a fix grounded in the spec.
